title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct minimum energy of 6.6 GeV must be provided.

title: Reaction Equation
description: Important Criteria: The reaction equation for antiproton production must be correctly stated.

title: Invariant Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of invariant mass and its relation to energy must be correctly derived.

title: Energy Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship E = 7m_p must be correctly identified and applied.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of energy should be consistent and correctly stated as GeV.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing the factor of 7 in the energy calculation or miscalculating the threshold energy will lead to a deduction.
